title: Liber Scivias (Latin, Heidelberg manuscript copy)
author: Hildegard of Bingen
description: A Latin manuscript witness to Hildegard of Bingen's visionary Scivias. The work presents an account of creation, salvation and religious life through visions and their theological interpretation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/Hildegard_Scivias).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
